info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Weather Alerts Radars-v2-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Radar API provides real-time access to weather alerts and radar information. This endpoint allows users to retrieve comprehensive details on active weather alerts, making it essential for businesses reliant on timely weather updates, such as event planners or logistics companies. Developers can integrate this data to enhance decision-making processes and improve safety measures. It serves as a critical resource for applications that require up-to-date environmental information.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves a comprehensive list of radar alerts, providing details about each alert's current status and specifications. It is essential for monitoring real-time events related to radar systems.

requestBody.description: The request body for fetching radar alerts, which must conform to the specified JSON schema. This includes parameters for filtering and customizing the radar alerts returned in the response.
